_comment: Curated under-review drug rows for build_drug_pages.py -- programs with a live FDA application but NO publicly disclosed action date, so no dataset event row can honestly carry them (a dataset row needs a date; inventing one violates the precision rules). Audit 2026-08-18c: AI grounding queries cite us for these drugs ('pdufa date for daraonrasib in usa' -- 14 citations, 47 Bing impressions, no page). The truthful answer to that query is 'the FDA accepted the application on X; no action date has been made public' -- and that answer is this file. Every row carries its primary source. when_text is rendered where a date would be; st 'Under review' marks the row live-but-undated.

_d.indication: Previously treated metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC)
_d.review: NDA accepted for review 2026-07-22 on the Phase 3 RASolute 302 trial (all primary and key secondary endpoints met, including overall survival). Breakthrough Therapy and Orphan Drug designations; Priority Review; selected for the FDA Commissioner's National Priority Voucher pilot. No PDUFA goal date was ever publicly disclosed. The FDA approved on August 26, 2026, as Rasonque, per the agency's own announcement 6.5 months before the user fee deadline.
_d.also_searched_note: People searching for this drug frequently type "daraonrasib", dropping the x. It is the same molecule: daraxonrasib (RMC-6236).

_d.indication: HR-positive, HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer with an ESR1 mutation detected during aromatase inhibitor and CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy, in combination with a CDK4/6 inhibitor (SERENA-6; approved as Etcamah)
_d.review: NDA accepted July 2025 on the Phase 3 SERENA-6 trial; Breakthrough Therapy Designation May 2025. The Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee voted 3-6 against on 2026-04-30, and the FDA extended the PDUFA goal date (announced 2026-05-27) without publicly disclosing the new date. The FDA granted accelerated approval on September 4, 2026, as Etcamah, in combination with a CDK4/6 inhibitor, with the Guardant360 CDx assay authorized as a companion diagnostic. Confirmatory studies are required.
_d.also_searched_note: Etcamah is the FDA-approved brand name for camizestrant (approved September 4, 2026).

rows.when_text: NDA accepted with Priority Review 2026-05-19; goal date not disclosed
rows.name: Asundexian

_d.indication: Prevention of secondary stroke in patients after a non-cardioembolic ischemic stroke or transient ischemic attack (OCEANIC-STROKE)
_d.review: Bayer announced on May 19, 2026 that the FDA accepted the New Drug Application for asundexian, an oral Factor XIa inhibitor, and granted Priority Review. The application rests on the Phase 3 OCEANIC-STROKE trial, which met its primary efficacy outcome (time to first ischemic stroke) and its primary safety outcome (time to ISTH major bleeding); results were presented at the International Stroke Conference 2026 and published in the New England Journal of Medicine. Asundexian received Fast Track designation in 2023. Bayer has not publicly disclosed the PDUFA goal date, so no date is stated here.
